'''Squad 5-Cresh''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] attached to [[Battlegroup Turak]]. During the [[Battle of Turak IV]], this squad was among the Imperial units dispatched to retrieve a [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortank]] from the [[Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit/Legends|Imperial Hammers Elite Armor Unit]]. The squad consisted of ten [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]], including one [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and one repeating [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] specialist. Apart from the repeating blaster rifle specialist, the members of this squad were armed with blaster rifles and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]].
